about: Where the asset library keeps what is not in git. Each path can be overridden by its variable (XGAMES_STORE, XGAMES_PRIVATE_PACKS, XGAMES_QUARANTINE, XGAMES_MIRRORS, XGAMES_KINDS). Where private packs live is an open creator decision (2026-10-13); the default is a folder in the person's home that is never pushed.
